svg.text: The floors 3^n/2^L, L = A020914(n), of Orders 0..40 on the octave [1/2, 1)
an upper record Order: its floor above every earlier floor, where A400061(n) = 0 (1, 3, 5, 17, 29)
a lower record Order: its floor below every earlier floor (1, 2, 7, 12); Order 1 is both, drawn red
dashed: the floors of n and n + 12, times the comma 3^12/2^19 (12 lines)
dotted (NW): the floors of n and n + 5, times 3^5/2^8 = 243/256 (5 lines)
at Order 0: 2^(−i/12) (first row) and 2^(−i/5) (second row), the equal temperaments of 12 and 5 steps
at x = 1 (the pole, the same point as 1/2): the dotted lines at the Orders k/λ, λ = log2(256/243) = 8 − 5 log2 3
